title: Program timeline
intro: Selected milestones connect field instruction, community relationships, spatial products and continuing research.

milestones.title: Balloon mapping and field GIS
milestones.summary: Three Columbia GIS courses combined balloon aerial imagery with ground observations at Black Rock Forest.
milestones.details: Public Lab balloon systems and visible/modified-infrared cameras preceded the later drone-teaching program. High winds limited the balloon operation.

milestones.title: Provost-supported teaching capability
milestones.summary: The Emerging Technology Grant supported drone and visualization equipment for GIS teaching.
milestones.details: The grant supported Drones and AR/VR for 3D Modeling in GIS. Later course fieldwork connected that capability with practical observation and analysis.

milestones.title: Callicoon field exercise
milestones.summary: SDEV3450 students collected aerial observations and developed student spatial analyses during a two-day field exercise.
milestones.details: Fieldwork connected vegetation, terrain and other geospatial questions with jointly produced student mapping. Layout detail is not independent accuracy.

milestones.title: Staten Island community mapping
milestones.summary: SDEV4650 students and community partners worked around 60 Hannah Street with drone observations and structural reconstruction.
milestones.details: Collaboratory funding included a teaching drone purchase. Follow-up work supported partner access to the student StoryMap and map layers through SIUC.

milestones.title: Campus tree-mapping workshop
milestones.summary: Nicole Davi hosted a William Paterson workshop connecting Field Maps tree observations with drone-derived products.
milestones.details: Visible/thermal camera observations and later elevation products supplied complementary views. Tree-identification performance was not evaluated by these displays.

milestones.title: NYC Parks UAS research begins
milestones.summary: EFPL and Natan Charytan began permitted Four Sparrow Marsh fieldwork and repeat mapping.
milestones.details: Kytt's first-hand account identifies April 18 as the first UAS operation approved by NYC Parks. Wind curtailed that operation; the team returned May 2. The photograph records the May visit.

milestones.title: North Shore and Morningside mapping
milestones.summary: December fieldwork extended the Parks portfolio and continued the Staten Island community partnership.
milestones.details: North Shore Esplanade was mapped December 1 and Morningside Park December 18. These are separate site activities with their own source dates and products.

milestones.title: Ground and aerial field methods
milestones.summary: SDEV3450 and WAC partners connected control/positioning observations with photogrammetry, LiDAR and complementary instruments.
milestones.details: The selected photogrammetric products are distinct from the logged IF1200A LiDAR acquisition. Private-site detail and raw archives remain outside the portfolio.

milestones.title: UNZA teaching and exchange
milestones.summary: Field collaboration and working sessions shared acquisition, photogrammetric processing and interpretation methods.
milestones.details: The working-session photograph has month-level collection context. The field-team photograph and campus products retain their own capture and mission-record dates.

milestones.title: Selected-site mapping around Mtukuzi
milestones.summary: Local collaborators and UNZA field colleagues documented village, school, agricultural, river and water-well sites.
milestones.details: The observations cover selected sites rather than the wider catchment. Fieldwork also supplied material for Raphael Sutiono and Kytt MacManus's TOPSTSCHOOL contribution.

milestones.title: Terrain and wind research
milestones.summary: Lamont surface geometry and field methods inform continued investigation of wind observations and airflow.
milestones.details: DURIP supported the IF1200A purchase for an ARO project. Terrain representation is a research input; the displayed photogrammetric sample does not validate a wind model.

milestones.title: Highbridge Park research
milestones.summary: Partner coordination and planning extend EFPL's NYC Parks research portfolio.
milestones.details: No completed Highbridge acquisition or mapped product is presented. Operational dates are not published here.
